title: Share requirements
summary: Product, shipping method, volume, destination and IOR needs.
label: YOUR REQUIREMENTS
heading: Start with what you know.
detail: Share the shipment information available. Mark undecided items as not sure.
items: Product & volume
Describe your goods and expected quantity, with units.
Shipping method
FCL, LCL, air freight or not sure.
Destination
Tell us where the shipment needs to go.
IOR needs
Indicate whether IOR support is needed or unclear.

title: Review conditions
summary: Acceptance, documents, handling, delivery and responsibilities.
label: CONDITIONS REVIEW
heading: Agree the scope and handovers.
detail: Confirm the acceptance conditions and each party’s responsibilities.
items: Acceptance & documents
Confirm the cargo scope and information required.
Warehouse handling
Review receiving, storage, picking and packing needs.
Delivery requirements
Confirm the destination and receiving conditions.
Responsibilities
Identify who handles each part and handover.

title: Confirm the quote
summary: Billing units, included items, additional charges and execution conditions.
label: QUOTE REVIEW
heading: Know what the quote includes.
detail: Confirm these items before arranging the next steps.
items: Billing units
How the shipment is calculated and what units are used.
Included services
Which services, documents and handling are covered.
Additional charges
Potential extra costs and when they may apply.
Execution conditions
Confirm the agreed conditions before arranging the next steps.
